coordinateConvention: Normalized image coordinates x/right,y/down; approximate visually estimated planted toe/foot-pad centers, not automatic alpha bottom. Anatomical crown excludes weapon/flag/stone shoulder towers/three-ring crown. Estimated tolerance ±20px (±35px for partly hidden foot). No runtime registration.
sharedLimits: Design candidates only; M14–M18 unique active skills are not implemented and still use base attack fallback.
Three independent key poses do not form continuous animation, complete multi-hit coverage, directional coverage or a validated 2K game render.
Camera is more frontal/lower than a strict elevated 45-degree runtime camera, especially M18; uniform runtime camera pass not approved.
No body PNG is cropped, resized, alpha-thresholded or otherwise edited by script. Generated PNG bytes preserved.
Normal alpha composites on light sandstone and dark purple have no broad RGB preview halos; faint low-alpha edge noise remains in source PNGs.
